questions.question: The mean proportional between 36 and a number N is three times the mean proportional between 8 and 32. The number N is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Mean proportional = √(a × b)

⇒ √(36 × N) = 3 × √(8 × 32)

⇒ 6√N = 3 × √256 = 3 × 16 = 48

⇒ √N = 8

⇒ N = 64

**∴ The correct answer is 64.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Mean proportional between 36 and N is 3 times the mean proportional between 8 and 32.

**Formula Used:**

Mean proportional between a and b = √(a × b)

questions.question: A man travels at 50 km/hr for 2 hours, the next at 40 km/hr for 2.5 hours and the next at 60 km/hr for 3 hours. What is his average speed (in km/hr, rounded off to two decimal places) for the whole journey?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time

Total Distance = (50 × 2) + (40 × 2.5) + (60 × 3) = 100 + 100 + 180 = 380 km

Total Time = 2 + 2.5 + 3 = 7.5 hours

Average Speed = 380 ÷ 7.5 = 50.666... ≈ 50.67 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 50.67 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Speed 1 (S₁) = 50 km/hr, Time 1 (T₁) = 2 hours

Speed 2 (S₂) = 40 km/hr, Time 2 (T₂) = 2.5 hours

Speed 3 (S₃) = 60 km/hr, Time 3 (T₃) = 3 hours

**Formula Used:**

Distance = Speed × Time

Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time

**Calculations:**

⇒ Distance 1 (D₁) = 50 × 2 = 100 km

⇒ Distance 2 (D₂) = 40 × 2.5 = 100 km

⇒ Distance 3 (D₃) = 60 × 3 = 180 km

⇒ Total Distance = 100 + 100 + 180 = 380 km

⇒ Total Time = 2 + 2.5 + 3 = 7.5 hours

⇒ Average Speed = 380 ÷ 7.5 = 3800 ÷ 75

⇒ Average Speed = 152 ÷ 3 = 50.666... km/hr

⇒ Rounding off to two decimal places, we get 50.67 km/hr.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Speed for Two Equal Distances

If an object covers two equal distances at speeds x and y respectively, the average speed for the entire journey is given by the formula: (2xy) ÷ (x + y).

Average Speed for Three Equal Distances

If three equal distances are covered at speeds x, y, and z respectively, the average speed is given by the formula: (3xyz) ÷ (xy + yz + zx).

Relative Speed

For two objects moving in the same direction, relative speed = |S₁ − S₂|. For objects moving in opposite directions, relative speed = S₁ + S₂.

questions.question: A and B can finish a work in 20 days while B and C can do it in 36 days. A started the work, worked for 5 days, then B worked for 10 days and the remaining work was finished by C in 15 days. In how many days could C alone have finished the whole work?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total Work = LCM(20, 36) = 180 units.

Efficiency of (A + B) = 180 ÷ 20 = 9 units/day | (B + C) = 180 ÷ 36 = 5 units/day.

Work split: 5A + 10B + 15C = 180 ⇒ 5(A + B) + 5(B + C) + 10C = 180

⇒ 5 × 9 + 5 × 5 + 10C = 180 ⇒ 70 + 10C = 180 ⇒ C = 11 units/day.

Time for C alone = 180 ÷ 11 = 16 ⁴/₁₁ days.

**∴ The correct answer is 16 ⁴/₁₁ days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Time taken by (A + B) = 20 days

Time taken by (B + C) = 36 days

Total Work and Efficiency

Total Work is calculated as the LCM of the given time periods. Efficiency is the work done per day and is inversely proportional to the time taken.

Work Split Technique

When individual times are unknown but pair sums are given, rearrange the worked days to form known pairs. Example: 5A + 10B = 5(A + B) + 5B.

Pipes & Cisterns

Follows the exact same LCM logic as Time & Work. Filling pipes have positive efficiency, while emptying (leakage) pipes have negative efficiency.

questions.question: A train travels the first 200 km of a journey at a speed of 100 km/h and the remaining 150 km at a speed of 75 km/h. What is the average speed (in km/h) of the train for the entire journey?

questions.question: The LCM of 46, 68, 136 and 138 is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Observe that 46 is a factor of 138 (46 × 3 = 138) and 68 is a factor of 136 (68 × 2 = 136).

Therefore, LCM (46, 68, 136, 138) is simply the LCM of the larger multiples: LCM (136, 138).

Since 136 = 2 × 68 and 138 = 2 × 69, their highest common factor is 2.

As 68 and 69 are consecutive integers, they are coprime (no further common factors).

LCM = 2 × 68 × 69 = 136 × 69 = 9384.

**∴ The correct answer is 9384.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Numbers: 46, 68, 136 and 138

**Method Used:**

We can find the LCM by taking the highest power of each prime factor present in the prime factorisation of all the numbers.

**Calculations:**

⇒ Prime factorisation of 46 = 2 × 23

⇒ Prime factorisation of 68 = 2² × 17

⇒ Prime factorisation of 136 = 2³ × 17

⇒ Prime factorisation of 138 = 2 × 3 × 23

⇒ The distinct prime factors found are 2, 3, 17, and 23.

⇒ The highest powers of these prime factors are 2³, 3¹, 17¹, and 23¹.

⇒ LCM = 2³ × 3 × 17 × 23

⇒ LCM = 8 × 3 × 17 × 23

⇒ LCM = 24 × 17 × 23

⇒ LCM = 408 × 23 = 9384

**∴ The correct answer is 9384.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

LCM (Least Common Multiple)

The smallest number that is a multiple of all given numbers. It can be found by multiplying the highest powers of all prime factors.

HCF (Highest Common Factor)

The largest number that perfectly divides the given numbers. The relationship between two numbers is given by: a × b = LCM × HCF.

Coprime Numbers

Two numbers are coprime if their only common factor is 1. Consecutive integers are always coprime. Their LCM is equal to their direct product.
</p

questions.question: Atul invests a sum of ₹5400 and Nirmal invests a sum of ₹10200 at the same rate of simple interest per annum. If, at the end of 5 years, Nirmal gets ₹480 more interest than Atul, then find the rate of interest per annum (in percentage).

Interest difference = (Difference in Principal × Rate × Time) ÷ 100

480 = [(10200 − 5400) × R × 5] ÷ 100

480 = 240 × R

R = 2

questions.question: Two trains are moving in opposite directions at speeds of 60 km/h and 70 km/h. The length of one train is 170 m. The time taken by them to cross each other is 26 seconds. The length (in m) of the other train, correct to 2 decimal places, is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Relative speed = 60 + 70 = 130 km/h = 130 × (5 ÷ 18) ≈ 36.11 m/s.

Total distance covered in 26 seconds = 36.11 × 26 = 938.86 m.

Length of the second train = Total distance − Length of first train

Length of the second train = 938.86 − 170 = 768.86 m.

**∴ The correct answer is 768.86 m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Speed of Train 1 (S₁) = 60 km/h

Speed of Train 2 (S₂) = 70 km/h

Length of Train 1 (L₁) = 170 m

Time to cross (T) = 26 seconds

**Formula Used:**

Relative Speed (opposite directions) = S₁ + S₂

questions.question:
A cylindrical tank has a capacity of 4774 m³. If the radius of the base is 7m, what is the depth?

{(Use } pi = (22)/(7) {)}
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Base Area of Cylinder = π × r² = (22 ÷ 7) × 7 × 7 = 154 m²

Volume of Cylinder = Base Area × Depth

⇒ Depth = Volume ÷ Base Area

⇒ Depth = 4774 ÷ 154 = 31 m

**∴ The correct answer is 31 m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Capacity (Volume) of the cylindrical tank, V = 4774 m³

Radius of the base, r = 7 m

**Formula Used:**

Volume of a cylinder (V) = π × r² × h

Where r is the radius and h is the depth (height) of the cylinder.

 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
• 
 
 r = 7 m
 
 
 
• 
 
• 
 
• 
 Depth (h) = ?
 
 
 V = 4774 m³

**Calculation:**

⇒ 4774 = (22 ÷ 7) × 7² × h

⇒ 4774 = (22 ÷ 7) × 49 × h

⇒ 4774 = 22 × 7 × h

⇒ 4774 = 154 × h

⇒ h = 4774 ÷ 154

⇒ h = 31 m

**∴ The correct answer is 31 m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Curved Surface Area of a Cylinder

The lateral or curved surface area is calculated as CSA = 2 × π × r × h.

Total Surface Area of a Cylinder

It includes the areas of both circular bases and the curved surface: TSA = 2 × π × r × (r + h).

Volume of a Cone

A cone with the same base radius and height has one-third the volume of a cylinder: V = (1 ÷ 3) × π × r² × h.

Marked Price & Discount

Discount is always calculated on the Marked Price (MP) of an article. It represents the reduction in price offered by the seller. The direct formula is Discount = MP − SP.

Successive Discounts

When two successive discounts of D₁% and D₂% are given, the Effective Discount Percentage is equivalent to: (D₁ + D₂ − (D₁ × D₂) ÷ 100)%.

Profit/Loss vs Discount Relation

Profit or Loss is always evaluated over the Cost Price (CP), whereas Discount applies to the Marked Price (MP). They are linked by the fundamental relation: CP × (100 + Profit%) = MP × (100 − Discount%).

questions.question: The price of fuel decreases by 15%, 25% and 35% in three successive months, but increases by 40% in the fourth month. What is the percentage increase/decrease in the price of fuel in the fourth month as compared to its original price?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Using the ratio method for successive percentage changes:

15% ↓ ⇒ 20 → 17 | 25% ↓ ⇒ 4 → 3 | 35% ↓ ⇒ 20 → 13 | 40% ↑ ⇒ 5 → 7

Initial parts product = 20 × 4 × 20 × 5 = 8000

Final parts product = 17 × 3 × 13 × 7 = 4641

Decrease % = [(8000 − 4641) ÷ 8000] × 100 = 3359 ÷ 80 = 41.9875% ≈ 41.98%

**∴ The correct answer is 41.98% decrease.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Successive changes in fuel price: Decreases by 15%, 25%, 35%, followed by an increase of 40%.

**Formula Used:**

Final Value = Initial Value × (1 ± R₁/100) × (1 ± R₂/100) × (1 ± R₃/100) × (1 ± R₄/100)

**Calculation:**

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 

 

 

 

 
 −15%
 −25%
 −35%
 +40%
 
 
 100
 Start

 
 85

 
 63.75

 
 41.44

 
 58.01
 Final

 

 Overall Decrease: 41.98%

Let the initial price of the fuel be 100.

⇒ Price after 1st month (15% decrease) = 100 × (1 − 0.15) = 85

⇒ Price after 2nd month (25% decrease) = 85 × (1 − 0.25) = 63.75

⇒ Price after 3rd month (35% decrease) = 63.75 × (1 − 0.35) = 41.4375

⇒ Price after 4th month (40% increase) = 41.4375 × (1 + 0.40) = 58.0125

⇒ Net decrease in price = Initial Price − Final Price = 100 − 58.0125 = 41.9875

⇒ Percentage decrease = (41.9875 ÷ 100) × 100% = 41.9875% ≈ 41.98%

**∴ The correct answer is 41.98% decrease.**

**__Additional Information__**

Successive Percentage Change

When a value undergoes successive changes of a% and b%, the net percentage change can be tracked using multiplying factors: Final = Initial × (1 ± a/100) × (1 ± b/100).

Fraction to Percentage Conversion

Converting percentage changes into fractions immensely simplifies calculation. For example, a 15% decrease becomes a multiplier of 85/100 or 17/20, and a 40% increase becomes 140/100 or 7/5.

Net Percentage Change via Ratio Method

For three or more changes, set up initial and final ratio parts for each step. Multiply all initial parts together and all final parts together to find the overall base and result, then compute the net percentage change directly.
</p

questions.question: Pramod has two grandsons Ashish and Ketan. 13 year old Ashish gets some money from Pramod’s wealth and 14 year old Ketan gets rest of the money. But Ashish and Ketan will get money only when they turn 24 years old. Till then the money is in a bank getting interest at rate 4% compounded annually. When both turn 24, they receive the same amount. How much had Pramod given Ketan (in ₹) initially, if total money with Pramod was ₹25500?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let Ashish's initial share be A and Ketan's initial share be K.

Time for Ashish = 24 − 13 = 11 years | Time for Ketan = 24 − 14 = 10 years.

Ratio of their shares K / A = (1 + R/100)⁽¹¹ − ¹⁰⁾ = (1 + 4/100)¹ = 104/100 = 26/25.

Ketan's share = 26 parts out of total (26 + 25) parts = 26/51 × 25500 = 26 × 500 = 13000.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹13000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total money with Pramod = ₹25500

Age of Ashish = 13 years, Age of Ketan = 14 years

Target Age for receiving money = 24 years

Rate of Compound Interest (R) = 4% annually

**Formula Used:**

Amount (A) = P(1 + R/100)T

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 
 
 Ashish (13 yrs)
 
 
 Ketan (14 yrs)
 
 
 Amount at Age 24
 
 

 T = 11 yrs @ 4%
 
 

 T = 10 yrs @ 4%

**Calculations:**

⇒ Time for Ashish (T₁) = 24 − 13 = 11 years

⇒ Time for Ketan (T₂) = 24 − 14 = 10 years

⇒ Let Ashish's initial share be P₁ and Ketan's initial share be P₂.

⇒ Amount received by Ashish = P₁(1 + 4/100)¹¹

⇒ Amount received by Ketan = P₂(1 + 4/100)¹⁰

⇒ Since both receive the same amount at age 24:

⇒ P₁(104/100)¹¹ = P₂(104/100)¹⁰

⇒ P₂ / P₁ = (104/100)¹¹ − ¹⁰ = 104/100 = 26/25

⇒ Ratio of Ketan's share to Ashish's share = 26 : 25

⇒ Sum of ratio parts = 26 + 25 = 51 parts

⇒ Total money = 51 parts = ₹25500

⇒ 1 part = 25500 ÷ 51 = 500

⇒ Ketan's share (P₂) = 26 × 500 = ₹13000

**∴ The correct answer is ₹13000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Division of Amount with Equal Maturity

When a given sum is divided into two parts P₁ and P₂ such that their amounts are equal after t₁ and t₂ years respectively at R% compound interest, the ratio of their principal amounts is given by P₁ / P₂ = (1 + R/100)t² − t¹.

Compound Interest Formula

A = P(1 + R/100)T, where A is the final amount, P is the initial principal, R is the annual interest rate, and T is the time in years.

Simple vs Compound Interest

For the first compounding period, SI and CI are equal. For subsequent periods, CI is always greater than SI as interest is earned on the previously accumulated interest.

questions.question: Ashok has ₹1617 with him. He divided it amongst his sons Raj and Varun and asked them to invest it at 10% rate of interest compounded annually. It was seen that Raj and Varun got same amount after 18 and 19 years respectively. How much (in ₹) did Ashok give to Raj?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Rate = 10% = 1/10 ⇒ Multiplying factor for Compound Interest = 11/10.

Difference in time for Varun and Raj = 19 − 18 = 1 year.

Ratio of principal shares (Raj : Varun) = 11¹ : 10¹ = 11 : 10.

Total parts = 11 + 10 = 21 parts ⇒ ₹1617

Raj's share (11 parts) = (1617 ÷ 21) × 11 = 77 × 11 = ₹847.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹847.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given:

⇒ Total amount = ₹1617

⇒ Rate of interest (R) = 10%

⇒ Time for Raj (n₁) = 18 years

⇒ Time for Varun (n₂) = 19 years

Formula Used:

⇒ Amount (A) = P(1 + R/100)ⁿ

 
 Total = ₹1617
 
 

 

 

 

 
 
 Raj (P1)
 Time = 18 years
 Amount = A1

 
 Varun (P2)
 Time = 19 years
 Amount = A2

 
 A1 = A2

Calculations:

Let the amount given to Raj be P₁ and to Varun be P₂.

⇒ P₁ + P₂ = 1617

⇒ Amount of Raj = P₁(1 + 10/100)¹⁸

⇒ Amount of Varun = P₂(1 + 10/100)¹⁹

Since both receive the same amount:

⇒ P₁ × (11/10)¹⁸ = P₂ × (11/10)¹⁹

⇒ P₁ / P₂ = (11/10)¹⁹ ÷ (11/10)¹⁸

⇒ P₁ / P₂ = 11 / 10

⇒ Ratio of Raj's share to Varun's share = 11 : 10

⇒ Total ratio parts = 11 + 10 = 21

⇒ 21 parts = 1617

⇒ 1 part = 1617 ÷ 21 = 77

⇒ Raj's share (11 parts) = 11 × 77 = 847

**∴ The correct answer is ₹847.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Compound Interest Formula

When interest is compounded annually, the final amount is given by A = P(1 + R/100)ⁿ, where P is Principal, R is the Rate of interest, and n is the Time period in years.

Equal Amount Distribution

If a total sum P is split into P₁ and P₂ such that their amounts are equal after t₁ and t₂ years respectively at the same rate R%, the ratio of their principals is P₁/P₂ = (1 + R/100)t² − t¹. The person whose money is invested for less time requires a larger principal share to reach the same final amount.

questions.question: Find the value of[ (17 times 16) times left{ 8 div 8 times ((18 - 11))/(7) right} ]

questions.question: There are 44 members in group A, 26 members in group B and 45 members in group C. All the members of these groups went to a restaurant. The average amount spent on each member of group A, B and C is ₹403, ₹383 and ₹228, respectively. The total average amount (in ₹) spent per member is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the assumed average be ₹300.

Deviations from 300: Group A = +103, Group B = +83, Group C = −72

Net deviation = (44 × 103) + (26 × 83) + (45 × (−72))

Net deviation = 4532 + 2158 − 3240 = +3450

Actual average = Assumed Average + (Net deviation ÷ Total members) = 300 + (3450 ÷ 115)

Actual average = 300 + 30 = ₹330

**∴ The correct answer is ₹330.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Members in Group A, B, and C = 44, 26, and 45 respectively.

Average amount spent = ₹403, ₹383, and ₹228 respectively.

**Formula Used:**

Combined Average = (n₁x₁ + n₂x₂ + n₃x₃) ÷ (n₁ + n₂ + n₃)

 
 Group A: 44
 Avg: ₹403

 
 Group B: 26
 Avg: ₹383

 
 Group C: 45
 Avg: ₹228

 
• 
 
• 
 
• 

 
 Total Members: 115
 Net Avg: ₹330

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total members = 44 + 26 + 45 = 115

⇒ Total amount spent by Group A = 44 × 403 = ₹17732

⇒ Total amount spent by Group B = 26 × 383 = ₹9958

⇒ Total amount spent by Group C = 45 × 228 = ₹10260

⇒ Total amount spent = 17732 + 9958 + 10260 = ₹37950

⇒ Combined Average = 37950 ÷ 115 = ₹330

**∴ The correct answer is ₹330.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Weighted Average

Used to find the combined average of multiple groups with varying sample sizes. Formula: Aw = (n₁A₁ + n₂A₂ + ... ) ÷ (n₁ + n₂ + ... )

Deviation Method

A time-saving shortcut method to calculate the average of large numbers without massive multiplications. Actual Average = Assumed Average + (Net Deviation ÷ Total Count).

Average Change Rule

When adding or removing an element from a set, the change in average is distributed equally among all remaining members. Change = (New Value − Old Average) ÷ Total Count.

questions.question: LCM and HCF of two numbers are 198 and 33 respectively. If one of the numbers is 99, then find the other number.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

We know that the product of two numbers is equal to the product of their LCM and HCF.

Other Number = (LCM × HCF) ÷ Given Number

Other Number = (198 × 33) ÷ 99

Other Number = 198 ÷ 3 = 66

**∴ The correct answer is 66.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

LCM of the two numbers = 198

HCF of the two numbers = 33

First number = 99

**Formula Used:**

First Number × Second Number = LCM × HCF

**Calculations:**

⇒ 99 × Second Number = 198 × 33

⇒ Second Number = (198 × 33) ÷ 99

⇒ Second Number = 198 × (33 ÷ 99)

⇒ Second Number = 198 × (1 ÷ 3)

⇒ Second Number = 198 ÷ 3

⇒ Second Number = 66

**∴ The correct answer is 66.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Product Rule of LCM and HCF

The product of any two numbers is always exactly equal to the product of their Least Common Multiple (LCM) and Highest Common Factor (HCF). Note that this rule applies specifically to exactly two numbers.

LCM and HCF of Fractions

To find the LCM of fractions, use the formula: LCM of numerators ÷ HCF of denominators. For the HCF of fractions, use: HCF of numerators ÷ LCM of denominators.

Co-prime Numbers

If two numbers are co-prime, meaning they share no common positive factor other than 1, their HCF is 1, and their LCM is directly calculated as the product of the two numbers.
